item.title: Metroland Summer Internship - Metroland Media
item.description: Metroland Summer Internship Summer Editorial Internships Joining Metroland’s editorial team as a summer intern will provide students currently enrolled in, or graduating from, journalism or related programs with an excellent launchpad for a rewarding career in journalism, and a paycheque. Up to 10 summer interns will work alongside Metroland’s talented journalists from May to August.
